permutation_group.description: Symmetric permutation group of discrete vocabulary labels acting on codebook assignments
permutation_group.invariance_condition: P(X) = P(pi(X)) implies identical continuous sequence distribution P(H_A) = P(H_B)

orthogonal_group.description: Orthogonal isometry group preserving Euclidean distance and inner products in embedding space
orthogonal_group.invariance_condition: W' = W Q^-1 and c' = Q c implies W' c' = W c (isometric representation indistinguishability)

symmetric_world_construction.world_a: Canonical codebook assignment phi_A: V -> C
symmetric_world_construction.world_b: Permuted codebook assignment phi_B = pi . phi_A with pi = (k_1 k_2)(v_1 v_2)

control_1_no_anchor.name: No-Anchor (Pure Blind Grounding)
control_1_no_anchor.interpretation: Complete permutation symmetry. All observables (H, D, y) are identical across symmetric worlds while z* diverges. Conditional entropy H(Z|obs) > 0 is mathematically unavoidable. Blind grounding is an identifiability impossibility.

control_2_1_anchor.name: Single Anchor Control
control_2_1_anchor.interpretation: Unanchored keys remain in an unbroken symmetry orbit with H(Z|obs) > 0. Mean baseline accuracy fails the 0.95 floor.

control_3_partial_anchor.name: Partial Anchor Control
control_3_partial_anchor.interpretation: Unanchored keys remain in an unbroken symmetry orbit with H(Z|obs) > 0. Mean baseline accuracy fails the 0.95 floor.

control_4_full_codebook.name: Full Codebook Grounding
control_4_full_codebook.interpretation: Full codebook breaks all permutation symmetries (orbit=1, H=0.0). The unlearned deterministic baseline B_det_emb achieves 100% ceiling with 0 learned parameters, eliminating any non-trivial learning margin.

impossibility_dominance_dilemma.theorem_name: Impossibility-Dominance Dilemma for Blind Continuous Grounding
impossibility_dominance_dilemma.statement: Let R be any continuous representation space under anchor information I_anchor. 1. If I_anchor < I_critical, the symmetry group G has non-trivial orbit, yielding H(Z | observables) > 0. Grounding is mathematically unidentifiable (Identifiability Impossibility). 2. If I_anchor >= I_critical, the symmetry is broken to the identity, yielding H(Z | observables) = 0. In this regime, the unlearned deterministic baseline B_det_emb achieves 1.000 accuracy with 0 learned parameters (Baseline Dominance). Therefore, the admissible hypothesis set H_residual = { R | H(Z|obs) = 0 and Acc(B_det_emb) < 0.95 } is identically EMPTY.
impossibility_dominance_dilemma.charter_recommendation: Retract residual Charter candidate H-C1-Residual. Blind grounding is mathematically unidentifiable, and grounded continuous representations are completely dominated by unlearned deterministic baseline B_det_emb.
